messages:
elaine_pm: Quick sync 011: EU enterprise wants an A/B experiment for the new routing policy but insists: no cross-border logs, and automatic user-facing fallback if latency > 300ms p95 for 3m. How do we design the rollout?

mike_research: key asks: 1) per-tenant/region A/B assignment, 2) telemetry bounded to EU KMS, 3) deterministic opt-in/opt-out for customers.

nora_eng: engineering constraints: we have per-tenant flags and region routing already. A/B split can be done via the routing layer but need deterministic hashing + sticky assignment. We should avoid global KV for assignments to keep EU data local.
luis_sre: ops concerns: automatic user-visible fallback for latency spikes is risky unless we have a cascading rollback plan. propose two-tier fallback: soft degrade (route to cheaper model variant) then hard fallback (route to legacy routing) if soft degrade doesn't recover in 5m.
elaine_pm: agree two-tier fallback is sensible. customers prefer immediate visible fallback vs silent regressions. we should include customer-facing banner in UI when fallback happens.
mike_research: for A/B metrics: primary KPI = latency p95 and error rate, secondary = model quality delta (via sample evaluation hooks). Need test harness to sample outputs and run gold prompts.
nora_eng: implementation sketch: 1) A/B assignment in-region using tenant_id % 100 < X. 2) telemetry aggregated by EU-only collectors -> KMS in EU. 3) gating service evaluates sliding windows of metrics and emits actions: NOOP / SOFT_DEGRADE / HARD_FALLBACK / ROLLBACK.
luis_sre: thresholds proposal: if p95 > 300ms for 3m -> SOFT_DEGRADE; if p95 stays > 350ms or error-rate > 2% for 5m -> HARD_FALLBACK. automated rollback if user-visible errors > 5% or user complaints flagged via support integration.
elaine_pm: regulatory check: legal insists the audit log for experiments be stored in EU for EU customers. prodops, can we automate that?
nora_eng: yes we can write experiment events to EU-only logging pipeline when tenant.region == "EU". small change in event producer, ETA 1 sprint.
prodops-bot: Reminder: create calendar block for "EU A/B bake (prod)" and include oncall; add runbook link. (automated)
mike_research: can we do a shadow run first? send 100% traffic in shadow to new routing and collect latency/quality without impacting users. then flip % of traffic in small increments: 1% -> 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> full. each step gated by metric windows.
luis_sre: agree on shadowing first. Also request: add a canary host pool that isolates model variant under test to avoid cache contamination.
elaine_pm: decision checklist for this thread: 1) require EU-local telemetry+audit for EU tenants, 2) shadow test then phased %-ramp with deterministic in-region assignment, 3) two-tier fallback (soft degrade to cheaper variant, then hard fallback to legacy), 4) automated gating + rollback thresholds as proposed. any objections?
nora_eng: no objections. will draft spec: routing-hash details, event tagging, canary pool config.
mike_research: no objections. I'll prepare evaluation prompt set and acceptance criteria for quality delta.
luis_sre: no objections. I'll write the rollback runbook and thresholds into SRE playbooks.
elaine_pm: next steps: nora to open spec PR and link canary config; mike to upload eval suite; luis to add runbook and pager triggers. weekly check-in Thurs 10:30.
prodops-bot: Action items created: #4821 spec PR, #4822 eval suite, #4823 rollback runbook. (automated)
elaine_pm: thanks team. I'll notify EU customer and align timelines.
